program: APPUI-01 - Windows 11 ARM64 Working App Visual Prototype
purpose: Test a clean implementation-facing app architecture in co-equal Light and Dark themes while keeping the Stage dark and dominant in both.

architecture.history_behavior: Causal history is adjacent to present Production context, not promoted to a permanent top-level mode.
architecture.live_workspace: Persistent Production/Scene/Perspective/Posture anchors + dark Stage + selected-Character inspector + Stage-external commands + adjacent causal history.
architecture.overview: Current Scene + current conditions + resume action + causal continuum showing how accepted events produced the present condition.

stage_reuse.note: Pass 02 reuses the preserved Pass 01 Stage viewport derived from the frozen Stage master; no Stage geometry, carrier, Character-cone or live-production art redesign is made. The overview uses one shared proportional preview for both themes.

drive_archive.folder_name: 18 APPUI-01 Windows Working Composition Pass 02 — Dual Theme Architecture

theme_tokens.selection_and_focus: Persistent selection and keyboard focus use separate non-color witnesses.
theme_tokens.identity: Character identity remains name/signature/text redundant; no color-only or portrait-only dependency.

pass_1_findings: Production Overview resume controls overlapped the Stage preview.
Light-theme tertiary text token measured 3.65:1 on the primary surface, below the 4.5:1 small-text floor.
Pass 01 permanent History navigation conflicted with the accepted shell rule that causal history is a semantic adjacent transition rather than a default top-level app mode.
repairs: Separated the Stage preview and resume controls into non-overlapping regions.
Darkened the light-theme tertiary semantic text token to 4.76:1 on white.
Removed History from durable navigation and represented causality adjacent to current Production state.
